description: The result of one Folketinget roll-call vote with the split by party: adopted or not, the published conclusion text, totals (for, imod, hverken for eller imod, fravaer=absent), and per party how many members voted each way with the member names listed for the votes that deviate from the party majority. Give vote_id, or a case number + session (a case with several votes returns the latest in full and lists all of them under votes_on_case; pick one with vote_id). totals_match_published says whether the counted for/against totals equal the numbers in the published conclusion. Party is the member's party as recorded on the actor register now. Danish text. Source: Folketinget, voting register.

case.description: Case number as printed, e.g. "B 36" or "L 12". With session.

session.description: Session code, e.g. "20261". Defaults to the current session when case is given.

name: folketinget_dk_vote_result
title: Folketinget Dk Vote Result
